summary.content:
Today's selection covers 79 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 60 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Gates Foundation Pledges $1 Billion to Combat A.I. Inequality
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: CISA: Critical VMware RCE flaw now exploited by ransomware gangs
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
